audienceText: Only the organiser of this event will see the health restriction. Food allergies belong under meals.
consent: I explicitly consent to the organiser of this event processing the participant's health information above to ensure their participation.
consentHint: Give consent to save the health information you enter.
errorTitle: The health restriction could not be loaded
notFilled: The applicant has not provided any health restriction yet.
notFilledHint: Missing information does not mean the participant has no health restriction.
organizerAccessText: Other users cannot see this health restriction. Food allergies are listed under meals.
organizerConsent: I confirm that I have the applicant’s explicit consent to the processing of the participant’s health restriction.
organizerNoRestriction: The participant confirmed having no health restriction.
organizerSaveFailed: Could not save the health restriction
organizerSaved: The health restriction has been saved.
organizerWriteHint: Enter the health restriction the participant told you about outside the application. A stored restriction can no longer be changed directly, only through the applicant’s request.
pendingText: The organiser will review the change. Until then the original health restriction stays valid.
title: Health restriction
